summary: Lemhi County lookout on the Salmon NF: a 1924 tower and cottage were reported, later pages describe a 1930s crow's nest; listed as abandoned, site drive-in.

facts.design: crow's nest (firelookout.com, FFLA list); 1924 newspaper reports describe a tower and cottage
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned, not gone; no source says what remains on the summit

events.note: Listed as a lookout on the 1918 Forest map
Salmon Herald reports construction of a tower and cottage; completion not confirmed
Guy E. Goff described as lookout man
Listed as a primary lookout on the 1926 visibility map

evidence.supports: about 14 miles northwest of Salmon, Salmon National Forest
lookout listed on the 1918 Forest map
evidence.quote: The 1918 Forest map lists Taylor Mountain , Lake Mountain , Haystack Mountain

evidence.supports: 1924 report: no improvements except a horse pasture below the mountain
evidence.quote: A Salmon Forest lookout report shows that there are no improvements at this site except for a small horse pasture below the mountain.
The report also states that a tower is needed at this point.

evidence.supports: September 1924: progress on a lookout tower and cottage
evidence.quote: He reports good progress being made in the construction of a lookout tower and cottage at that place.

evidence.supports: Guy E. Goff named as lookout man, 1925
evidence.quote: Guy E. Goff, who is lookout man on Haystack mountain, near Leesburg

evidence.supports: A.C. Ludwig packed supplies to the lookout, 1926
evidence.quote: A.C. Ludwig packed up a lot of supplies to Haystack mountain lookout last week.

evidence.quote: The 1926 map indicates Lake Mountain, Stein, Haystack, Sheepeater, Two Point Peak, and Sagebrush as primary lookouts.

corrections.why: The FFLA list gives Haystack Mountain (Lemhi) as Abandoned, not Gone, and no source says the structure is gone
Truncated page title on Idaho Fire Lookouts; other sources do not use this name

sources.title: An Overview of the Lookouts on the Salmon National Forest by Bing Young (1982)

notes_for_editor: Thin and conflicting. The 1924 newspaper items (via the Forest Lookouts page) describe a tower and cottage under construction; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts describe a 1930s crow's nest. The story states both and does not reconcile them. Record status 'gone' is not supported: FFLA says Abandoned. The FFLA list also has a separate Haystack Mountain in Shoshone County (47.76125, -115.94824), which is not this lookout. Firelookout.com gives elevation 8800 ft; no facts key for elevation, so omitted. The 'drive-in' label is not checked on the ground. No new photos.
